security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown links, inline file paths, or prompt examples. One connector command and one YouTube API key reference are confirmed because they require external command execution and secret-bearing environment access.

remediation.issue: External connector command execution is documented in SKILL.md line 58.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before running the connector, validate creator handles, and invoke the script with structured arguments.

remediation.issue: The YouTube connector depends on YOUTUBE_API_KEY in SKILL.md line 58.
remediation.suggestion: Document the required scope, never persist the key, and provide a manual-data path when the key is unavailable.

remediation.issue: Deep relative Markdown links trigger path traversal scanners across SKILL.md and references/scoring-templates.md.
remediation.suggestion: Use marketplace skill references or repository-root links where supported to reduce false positive audit noise.

content.value_statement: Teams need a consistent way to compare shortlisted creators before outreach. This skill turns audience, content, brand, engagement, and partnership signals into ranked go or pass recommendations.
actual_capabilities: Scores shortlisted creators across five weighted fit dimensions.
Adjusts weights for awareness, engagement, conversion, brand building, or long-term partnership goals.
Applies ACE veto checks for real followers, brand safety, and engagement authenticity.
Ranks multiple influencers with dimension-level comparisons and clear verdicts.
Produces a saved fit-score report and handoff summary for downstream planning.
Can use supplied YouTube connector metrics when the environment is configured.
limitations: It does not discover new influencers for a campaign.
Scores depend on the quality of supplied audience and engagement data.
Connector-based YouTube metrics require a configured API key.
It does not send outreach, negotiate rates, or manage contracts.

use_cases.title: Prioritize a creator shortlist
use_cases.description: Compare known creators and choose the strongest outreach targets for a campaign.

use_cases.title: Defend partner recommendations
use_cases.description: Create a documented scorecard that explains why each creator is recommended or passed.

use_cases.title: Standardize agency evaluations
use_cases.description: Apply the same scoring framework across client briefs, platforms, and creator niches.

prompt_templates.title: Score one creator
prompt_templates.prompt: Score @creator for our brand campaign. Use the default weighting and give me a go or pass verdict.

prompt_templates.title: Rank a shortlist
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare @creator1, @creator2, and @creator3 for our campaign. Rank them and explain the strongest fit.

prompt_templates.title: Tune for conversion
prompt_templates.prompt: Score these creators for a conversion campaign. Increase audience match weight and flag any engagement authenticity risks.

prompt_templates.title: Audit with veto gates
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced due diligence before budget approval
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate this creator shortlist with ACE veto checks, custom weights, evidence notes, and a final partner tier for each creator.

output_examples.input: Score @sustainablesarah for a sustainable fashion conversion campaign.
output_examples.output: The skill returns dimension scores, evidence notes, a final rating, key concerns, and a recommended verdict.

output_examples.input: Rank three fitness creators for a product launch.
output_examples.output: The skill produces a ranked comparison, explains tradeoffs by dimension, and identifies which creators to pursue or pass.

output_examples.input: Review a creator with suspected bought engagement.
output_examples.output: The skill checks engagement authenticity, applies veto guidance when evidence supports it, and caps the final recommendation when needed.

best_practices: Provide target audience, campaign goal, budget range, and known creator metrics before scoring.
Use the same weights and evidence standards for every creator in one comparison.
Verify high-scoring creators with recent content checks before approving outreach.
anti_patterns: Do not use the skill to discover creators from scratch.
Do not treat scores as reliable when audience or engagement data is missing.
Do not override veto findings just because a creator has a high follower count.

faq.question: What does this skill score?
faq.answer: It scores audience match, content quality, brand alignment, engagement quality, and partnership potential.

faq.question: Can it compare multiple influencers?
faq.answer: Yes. It can rank a shortlist and show dimension-by-dimension differences.

faq.question: Does it find new influencers?
faq.answer: No. It evaluates creators that the user already provides.

faq.question: Does it need live platform access?
faq.answer: No. Users can supply data manually, but configured connectors can improve measurement quality.

faq.question: Can it support different campaign goals?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes different weighting guidance for awareness, engagement, conversion, brand building, and long-term goals.

faq.question: Does it send outreach messages?
faq.answer: No. It stops at scoring, ranking, and recommendation handoff.
